name: Snap Focal Point to Slice with Fixed Basis
definition: A mechanism to snap a focal point to a slice grid. The current implementation lacks a fixed basis focal point, causing non-idempotent snaps, non-returning round trips, and multiple snap positions for points within one slice.
summary: Snap Focal Point to Slice with Fixed Basis anchors slice grids to a static reference point, ensuring deterministic, idempotent snapping and eliminating round-trip errors caused by floating-point inaccuracies.
